privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Your trust is our priority. Learn how UNITED protects your data and ensures secure business interactions.

collection.title: Data Collection & Usage
collection.content: UNITED is committed to protecting the privacy of our partners within the Egyptian market. We collect only the information necessary to facilitate local food supply procurement and business inquiries, specifically names, company details, contact information, and specific supply requirements provided via our RFQ and Contact forms.

email.title: Email Handling
email.content: Information submitted through our forms is transmitted directly to our sales and support teams via secure email protocols. We do not store this data in a public-facing database at this stage. Your data is used exclusively for professional communication regarding your specific requests.

hosting.title: Hosting & Cookies
hosting.content: Our platform is hosted on secure enterprise infrastructure. We use minimal cookies essential for site functionality and performance optimization. We do not use third-party tracking cookies for advertising purposes.

overview.title: Service Overview
overview.content: By accessing the UNITED platform, you agree to these terms. UNITED provides a high-efficiency procurement interface for professional food supply services, focusing on B2B agricultural supply chains within the Egyptian market.

procurement.title: Procurement Requests
procurement.content: All RFQs submitted via our platform constitute an invitation to treat and not a binding contract until formal procurement agreements are signed. UNITED reserves the right to verify business credentials before fulfilling supply requests.

liability.title: Liability & Compliance
liability.content: UNITED operates in strict compliance with international food safety standards (HACCP, ISO 22000). While we strive for 100% platform availability and logistical accuracy, we are not liable for indirect losses resulting from site downtime or supply chain disruptions beyond our HUB control.

hero.label: Institutional Heritage
hero.title:
A Decade of Operational
Excellence
hero.description: Since 2013, UNITED has functioned as the institutional supply bridge between Egypt’s agricultural output and the global requirements of the hospitality sector.

chapter_01.label: The Foundation
chapter_01.title: Institutional Roots
chapter_01.content: Founded in 2013, UNITED was built to stabilize the fragmented local supply chain. We replaced volatility with precision, establishing a baseline for quality that meets the rigorous demands of enterprise procurement.

chapter_02.label: Human Infrastructure
chapter_02.title: Specialized Workforce
chapter_02.content: Our strength lies in our workforce of 114 specialized employees. From agronomists to cold-chain logistics experts, our team manages every tactical layer of the supply journey from our central logistics base.

chapter_03.label: The Hub
chapter_03.title: Obour Logistics Engine
chapter_03.content: We operate from the Obour Industrial Area, managing a centralized 1200m² hub that serves as the engine for all regional dispatch. Our facility is engineered for high-frequency grading and consistency.

chapter_04.label: Market Reach
chapter_04.title: Hospitality Alignment
chapter_04.content: UNITED is the preferred partner for the region’s hospitality elite. We secure supply chains for groups like Fairmont and Four Seasons with localized logistics precision.
